mintAuthority.summary: AZND native issuance is confined to the Monad AZND deployment. Its mint function is available to three current TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE holders: the PrimaryMarket contract, one EOA, and one EIP-7702 delegated EOA; the Monad AccessManager default admin can change that role set. PrimaryMarket is KYC- and allowlist-gated but its verified mint path has no economic amount cap or whole-supply reconciliation invariant. Ethereum AZND is a LayerZero OFT bridge representation and its burn/mint, peer, adapter, escrow, Endpoint, and bridge-upgrade controls are scored under Bridge Risk rather than Mint Authority.

controls.label: Monad AZND PrimaryMarket minter
controls.evidence: At Monad block 87687688, AZND 0x4917a5ec...1fE8 returned immutable PRIMARY_MARKET 0xe64730de...0c89 and AccessManager 0x7b14860e...b47f; the AccessManager returned true for TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE on the PrimaryMarket. Verified AZND source restricts mint(receiver, amount) to TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE, while Mu Digital documents PrimaryMarket as its KYC-gated mint/redeem contract.

controls.label: Monad AZND TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Monad block 87687688, AccessManager 0x7b14860e...b47f returned true for TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE on 0xf6e5255f...1ca8. The account had no deployed bytecode at that block. Verified AZND source allows every current TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE holder to call mint(receiver, amount) without an onchain amount cap.

controls.label: Monad AZND TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE delegated EOA
controls.evidence: At Monad block 87687688, AccessManager 0x7b14860e...b47f returned true for TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE on 0x8b33f017...bd0b. Its 23-byte 0xef0100 delegation designator points to 0x63c0c19a...ae32b, identifying an EIP-7702 delegated EOA rather than a standalone contract authority. Verified AZND source permits this role holder to call uncapped mint(receiver, amount).

controls.label: Monad AccessManager default admin
controls.evidence: At Monad block 87687688, AccessManager 0x7b14860e...b47f returned true for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on 0x8b5f269f...0068, which had no deployed bytecode. Verified AccessManager source makes DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE the admin for role grants and revocations, so this EOA can change AZND's TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE holder set.

controls.label: Monad AccessManager MANAGER_PRIMARY_MARKET parameter authority
controls.evidence: At Monad block 96611302, Mu AccessManager 0x7b14860e...b47f returned true for MANAGER_PRIMARY_MARKET on 0x8b5f269f...0068, and the same code-empty EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The manager role can change PrimaryMarket's treasury 0xf3cdc00cca19f336b1c1b4bd684a949124a93ea7, PriceFeed 0x8b9670c5e4d9f1c14f1f9fe625dd099924ad4d4f, deposited and received-token allowlists, and whitelist, so it is native parameter authority. AccessManager exposes hasRole but no enumerable role-member view; this fixed-block observation does not prove that the EOA is the sole MANAGER_PRIMARY_MARKET holder.

review.evidence: Mu Digital documents KYC-gated primary minting through PrimaryMarket. At Monad block 96611302, verified AZND source and RPC reads resolve three TOKEN_MINTER_ROLE holders: PrimaryMarket 0xe64730de...0c89, EOA 0xf6e5255f...1ca8, and EIP-7702 delegated EOA 0x8b33f017...bd0b; the AccessManager default admin is 0x8b5f269f...0068 and can change the role set. The same EOA holds MANAGER_PRIMARY_MARKET, which can change PrimaryMarket treasury, PriceFeed, token allowlists, and whitelist; the role is not enumerable, so additional holders are not excluded. PrimaryMarket proxy 0xe64730de...0c89 resolves to UUPS implementation 0xe5f8ec54...28eb, and AccessManager proxy 0x7b14860e...b47f resolves to UUPS implementation 0xef1776ed...5461; no timelock or Safe was evidenced. The verified native mint path has no economic amount cap or whole-supply reconciliation invariant, so authorityPosture remains unbounded-reconciled and economicCapSemantics remains unbounded. Accountable's independent proof-of-solvency dashboard provides periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision; no named prudential supervisor for AZND issuance was evidenced. Ethereum AZND is a bridge representation and its OFT, adapter, peer, Endpoint, escrow, and bridge-upgrade authorities are excluded from this native review and recorded under Bridge Risk.
